name: drag-joystick
description: Real pointer: a drag is a joystick around the press point (screen space, so the moving chase camera can't feed back). Up = drive, sideways = steer, a tiny drag does nothing, release stops input.

steps.label: a click / tiny drag (dead zone) does not start driving
held still: input does not drift as the camera follows
the plough (and the chase camera) turned left a lot

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(window.__game.getState().controls) === JSON.stringify(window.__held) || (() => { throw new Error('controls drifted while the camera turned') })()
